Owner.selfGuardian: You cannot be your own guardian
Owner.notVerifiedRequired: Not verified: this vault requires verified guardians
Owner.notVerifiedPolicy: Not verified: required by the policy below
Owner.createIntro: Choose 3–7 guardians from the people who have accepted your invitation. Guardians never see your files; together (at the threshold) they can release the key to your beneficiaries when you are gone.
Owner.fewGuardians: You have {count, plural, one {# accepted guardian} other {# accepted guardians}}; a vault needs at least 3. Invite people by email and ask them to accept.
Owner.requireVerifiedBody: Every guardian must have proved, with a zero-knowledge proof, that they are one real Aadhaar holder, so one person cannot hold several guardian seats. Their Aadhaar data never leaves their browser.
Owner.requireVerifiedRotate: Applies to this set and to later changes.
Owner.thresholdLabel: Guardians needed to reconstruct the key (threshold)
Owner.intervalHint: How often you promise to check in. Minimum 5 minutes.
Owner.frozenNote: While frozen, no claim can be raised, approved or finalized.
Owner.stepUnlocking: Unlocking your files' keys with your encryption key…
Owner.stepReadingKeys: Reading the new guardians' public keys…
Owner.stepSplitting: Splitting each file's key for the new guardians…
Owner.stepConfirm: Confirm the guardian change in your wallet…
Owner.invalidKey: A guardian's registered key is invalid
Owner.notConfirmed: The guardian change was not confirmed. Nothing was changed.
Owner.partialReshare: Guardians were replaced, but asset #{id} was not re-shared yet. Use “Re-share to new guardians” on that file to finish.
Owner.replacePrompt: A guardian lost their key or stopped responding? You can replace them at any time.
Owner.replaceIntro: This opens each file's key with your encryption key, splits it again for the new guardians, then updates the vault and every file on-chain. It counts as a check-in (any open claim is voided).
Owner.sealedNote: {count, plural, one {# sealed file will be re-shared, which takes one wallet confirmation each.} other {# sealed files will be re-shared, which takes one wallet confirmation each.}}
Owner.inviteFirst: To add a new guardian, invite them by email first and wait for them to accept.
Owner.overAsked: {assets}: more approvals are required than the new set has guardians, so a claim on {count, plural, one {this asset} other {these assets}} could only finish after its attestation deadline, when the guardian threshold alone is enough.
Owner.fileLabel: File (encrypted in your browser before upload, max ~17 MB)
Owner.letterHint: {chars} / {max} characters. Encrypted in your browser; the beneficiary reads it on screen after release.
Owner.letterPlaceholder: Write what you want them to read…
Owner.noBeneficiaries: You have no accepted beneficiaries yet. Invite the person by email; once they accept, you can reserve files for them.
Owner.selfBeneficiary: You cannot be your own beneficiary
Owner.requireZk: Require a fresh identity proof to raise a claim: only the verified person behind this wallet can start it.
Owner.requireAge: Require proof that the beneficiary is over 18 to finalize. Only that single fact is proven; no date of birth is stored.
Owner.beneficiaryUnverified: This beneficiary has not verified an identity yet. Ask them to verify first (Account page).
Owner.challengeHint: Time you have to object after a claim (min 5 minutes)
Owner.deadlineHint: After this, the guardian threshold alone suffices (min 5 minutes)
Owner.periodsTooShort: Every period must be at least 5 minutes.
Owner.progSplitting: Splitting the key and encrypting each share to its guardian…
Owner.assetsLoadFailed: Could not load your files. Retrying…
Owner.assetsEmptyHint: Reserve a file above. It is encrypted in your browser and only your chosen beneficiary can ever open it.
Owner.verifiedLetterOwn: Integrity verified: your letter matches the on-chain hash.
Owner.verifiedFileOwn: Integrity verified: "{name}" matches the on-chain hash.
Owner.hashMismatch: Decrypted file does not match the on-chain hash
Owner.assetLineData: ciphertext {cid} · hash {hash} · {approvals, plural, one {# approval} other {# approvals}} · challenge {challenge} · inactivity {inactivity}
Owner.assetLineCrypto: crypto · {approvals, plural, one {# approval} other {# approvals}} · challenge {challenge} · inactivity {inactivity}
